core_problem_solved: To provide only the API interfaces and classes for the Jakarta Commons Logging (JCL) facade, allowing libraries to code against the API without forcing a specific runtime implementation on their users.
key_features: Contains the core `org.apache.commons.logging.Log` and `LogFactory` classes that application code compiles against.
era_and_niche: The compile-time dependency for libraries that wanted to use the JCL logging facade in the early-to-mid 2000s.
reason_for_obsolescence: This API is **obsolete** for the same reasons as the main library. The modern, standard logging API to code against is **`org.slf4j:slf4j-api`**. To handle legacy libraries that still use JCL, the `jcl-over-slf4j` bridge is the recommended solution.
